name: air-studio
description: An experimental NuPhy Lab lighting studio for NuPhy Air75 V3 on macOS

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p bin && swiftc -target "$(uname -m)-apple-macosx13.0" native/HIDBridge.swift -O -o bin/HIDBridge -framework IOKit -framework AppKit -framework ApplicationServices && swiftc -target "$(uname -m)-apple-macosx13.0" native/main.swift native/AppHost.swift native/AudioCapture.swift -O -o bin/AirStudio -framework AppKit -framework WebKit -framework Carbon -framework AVFoundation -framework CoreAudio -framework Accelerate
scripts.build: npm run build:icon && npm run build:native && npm run build:ui
